end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0234 (a b c : ℝ) (h_a_pos : a > 0) (h_neg_discr : b^2 - 4 * a * c < 0) : ∀ x : ℝ, a * x^2 + b * x + c > 0 := by

  have h1 : a * x^2 + b * x + c = a * (x + b / (2 * a))^2 + c - b^2 / (4 * a) := by

  have h3 : c - b^2 / (4 * a) > 0 := by
    rw [h1]
    linarith [h_neg_discr, h_a_pos]
  exact add_pos h2 h3
end Nl2LeanCandidate
